description: CWapi is a **non-MCP** local execution bridge for web-based ChatGPT, designed for **ChatGPT Plus and Pro users**. It does not rely on MCP integration or consume Codex Agent quota. Instead, it connects regular ChatGPT web conversations to a local Windows Runner.
